damei_chambongo: Place named by Dampier on the southern coast of Mindanao.
damei_sologue: People whom Dampier identifies as Sologues.
damei_sebo: Place named by Dampier in the Philippine islands.
damei_panay: Place in the Philippines passed on the voyage.
damei_pracel: Place name of the shoals in Dampier's account.
damei_cochinchina: Place named in the account for the homeland of the inhabitants of Condore.
damei_malaya: Place name used in referring to the Malay country, people and speech.
damei_guinea: Place on the West African coast in the comparison of customs.
damei_champa: Place named in the account as the kingdom of the Chams.
damei_palimbam: Place in Sumatra from which the Chinese junk sailed.
damei_lizard: Place name of the English headland used in reckoning longitude.
damei_september: Ninth month of the source calendar.
damei_islam: The faith of those Dampier calls Mahometans.
damei_sultan: Title used for the sovereign of Mindanao.
damei_read: Captain Read, commanding the ship after Swan.
damei_pangasanam: Place named as the little town at the north end of Luconia.
damei_pongassinay: Place which Dampier provisionally identifies with Pangasanam.
damei_coppinger: The ship's surgeon who described Manila.
damei_fitzgerald: John Fitz-Gerald, Irish member of Swan's company.
damei_pegu: Place named as a source of pickles.
damei_maderas: Place named in the comparison of mango varieties.
damei_achar: Local culinary term explicitly interpreted by Dampier as sauce.
damei_pulo: Malay word for island quoted and interpreted by Dampier.
damei_java: Place between the Sunda Strait and the eastern islands.
damei_sunda: Place name of the strait between Sumatra and Java.
damei_borneo: Place named in the Malay language discussion.
damei_ascension: Place in the Atlantic where turtles lay their eggs.
damei_jack: Fruit known in the Indies with clusters borne directly on the trunk.
damei_durian: The East Indian fruit named in the comparison.
damei_cacao: Tree bearing cacao fruits directly on its trunk.
damei_bonzie: Dampier’s term for the priests officiating in the narrative.
damei_sillabar: Place of an English settlement in Sumatra.
damei_wallis: Daniel Wallis, a member of the canoe crew.
damei_herman: Given name of the surgeon Coppinger.
damei_daniel: Given name of Wallis of the canoe crew.
damei_kris: Malay dagger called a cresset in the voyage.
damei_prata: Place of reefs between Manila and Canton.
damei_canton: Place called Canton or Quantung in the voyage, also the name of its principal city.
damei_quantung: Place name used for the southern Chinese province.
damei_tartar: Historical source term for the ruling dynasty and its people.
damei_amoy: Place on the coast of Fukien visited by European ships.
damei_fokieu: Place name for the province in which Amoy lies.
damei_macao: Place inhabited by Portuguese and Chinese people.
damei_samciu: The distilled Chinese drink named by Dampier.
damei_hocciu: The Chinese brewed drink described by Dampier.
damei_basidraught: A local beverage of fermented sugar-cane juice.
damei_corpussant: The mariners’ name for a luminous atmospheric phenomenon in a storm.
damei_bermuda: Place in the Atlantic whose dangerous reefs were feared by mariners.
damei_stjohnchina: Place on the Canton coast, distinct from the Philippine island of St John.
damei_dorset: Place in England whose rolling downs Dampier compares to the islands.
damei_wiltshire: Place in England whose downs resemble the Piscadores.
damei_anhay: Place name given as an alternative to Amoy.
damei_sanctum: Latin words Dampier names in discussing the mariners' expression.
damei_arlington: Place named as the house where Dampier left his wife.
damei_guatimala: Place whose high land introduces the description of the coast towards California.
damei_bengal: Place name of the bay on the Indian coast.
damei_gilolo: Place named among the islands east of Sumatra.
damei_timor: Place named for high Indian Ocean shores.
damei_deal: Place in Kent whose yawls are compared with the island boats.
damei_bullawan: Mindanao word meaning gold, heard in the Bashees.
damei_hall: Surname of Robert Hall, a sailor left ashore during the storm.
damei_october: Tenth month of the source calendar.
damei_macasser: Place and Dutch trading town on the island of Celebes.
damei_omba: Place among the Indonesian islands on the passage to Timor.
damei_pentare: Place passed among the Indonesian islands.
damei_alfoor: People against whom Raja Laut campaigned.
damei_rofy: One of Swan's men who reached Ternate.
damei_nelly: One of Swan's men who reached Ternate.
damei_batavia: Place on Java administered by the Dutch.
damei_harthope: Merchant in Swan's party who died at Mindanao.
damei_smith: Merchant in Swan's party who died at Mindanao.
damei_cocosindian: Place in the Indian Ocean, distinct from the Pacific island of that name.
damei_november: Eleventh month of the source calendar.
damei_records: London captain of the Blessing caught in the Guinea waterspout.
damei_blessing: The English ship in the account of a waterspout.
damei_canby: John Canby, steward and quartermaster who gave the account.
damei_wise: Abraham Wise, chief mate of the Blessing.
damei_jefferies: Leonard Jefferies, second mate of the Blessing.
damei_abraham: Given name of Wise, chief mate of the Blessing.
damei_leonard: Given name of Jefferies, second mate of the Blessing.
damei_hodmadod: Dampier’s historical name for the people he compares with Australians.
damei_monomatapa: Place used in the author's comparison of the peoples.
damei_bonairy: Place in the Caribbean where Dampier saw friction fire-making.
damei_gurry: Cry recorded by Dampier without translation.
damei_nassau: Place in the islands to the west of Sumatra called Nassau and Nassaw in the source.
damei_hogisland: Place west of Sumatra named for its hogs.
damei_melory: Local name given by Dampier for the Nicobarese fruit tree and its bread fruit.
damei_audeman: Place north of the Nicobar islands called Audeman in the source.
damei_damarell: Surname of John Damarell, sent ashore to fetch Dampier.

damei_meridian: The geographical line whose places share local noon.
damei_declination: The Sun’s angular distance north or south of the celestial equator.
damei_mango: The fruit named mango in Dampier’s account.
damei_junk: The broad cargo carrier of eastern Asian waters.
damei_proa: The sailing craft of the islands which Dampier calls proes.
damei_civil_day: The date as counted in the calendar at a given place, distinguished from a local solar day.
damei_watertight: Of a vessel closely built against leakage.
damei_correct: To amend a calculated value to remove an error.
damei_differ: To differ in amount or character.
damei_lessen: To reduce a counted difference, as in navigation.
damei_count_n: The count of elapsed units as distinct from their individual duration.
damei_coconut: The large palm nut used for its kernel, milk, and oil.
damei_calico: Woven cotton cloth carried in the Manila trade.
damei_quartermaster: The officer concerned with the company’s provisions and shares.
damei_master: The ship’s officer in charge of navigation, distinct from its captain.
damei_reach_tack: To make progress along a coast under an adverse wind by working the vessel to windward.
damei_anchor: The anchoring iron and, as a verb, bringing a ship to anchor.
damei_track: An impression left by an animal’s foot, distinguishing tracks from a plotted voyage.
damei_scrub: To remove fouling from the outside of a hull by rubbing it clean.
damei_iguana: The lizard called guano in the voyage.
damei_monsoon: A seasonally reversing wind of the Indian seas.
damei_lacquer: Varnish used to finish cabinets in the East Asian manner.
damei_tea: Prepared tea leaves or the drink brewed from them.
damei_chinaroot: The medicinal root obtained from China, Jamaica and elsewhere.
damei_umbrella: A portable cover carried over the head for protection from sun or rain.
damei_mizzen: The aftermost sail named separately from the main and foresail.
damei_scupper: A drain for water at the edge of the deck.
damei_sheetanchor: The ship’s heavy spare anchor, used in severe conditions.
damei_banana: Dampier’s bonano, differentiated from the plantain in the same enumeration.
damei_pump: A shipboard device for lifting bilge water and discharging it over the side.
damei_cockatoo: The large white parrot Dampier calls crockadore.
damei_squall: The violent brief winds termed tornadoes, distinct from the water spouts Dampier describes.
damei_periwinkle: The little edible shore snail listed with cockles and mussels.
damei_crawfish: Long-bodied crustacean used as a comparison with a land animal in the account.
damei_toddy: Sap tapped from palms for drinking.
damei_paddle: Short handheld blade used to propel or steer without an oarlock.
damei_cannibal: Person alleged to eat human flesh; Dampier questions the common reports.
